experiment.variant: Paper Appendix C multi-head variant preserving original model; notebook cosine spatial weights on concatenated Q/K channels
experiment.target_layer: Final visual transformer block (index 11 of 12); CLS attention context before output projection
experiment.channel_weights: Gradient of raw cosine target with respect to CLS pre-projection attention context
experiment.spatial_weights: Min-max-normalized cosine of unscaled CLS query and patch keys, using concatenated channels as in official notebook
experiment.map: ReLU(sum_channels(gradient_cls * patch_value * spatial_weight)); no per-map normalization for evaluation
experiment.pixel_projection: 7x7 to 224x224 bilinear; inverse actual processor center crop then inverse resize; zero unseen pixels
experiment.slic_aggregation: Mean relevance over every working-image pixel in each saved Experiment4 SLIC region
experiment.secondary_endpoint: PositiveOnly-PDAUC on native nonnegative ReLU support
experiment.evaluator: Unmodified Experiment3 matched_deletion and Experiment2 preference_deletion; Telea radius3, original-image cumulative masks, whole-region first crossing, gamma from original frozen model
experiment.sample: Exact 300 Experiment4 images and captions; no resampling or replacement
experiment.model_updates: None; no optimizer; all parameters frozen; autograd.grad on last-block activations only
